proposed_widenings.name: passive_trigger (class-feature family)
proposed_widenings.justification: Heroic Warrior fires automatically at the start of every turn during combat — no player activation, no use-count resource, no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which models explicitly triggered features with an activationCost, a UseCountResource, and a RestResetCadence. None of those fields apply honestly here. A new family is needed for features that auto-fire on a game window subject to a state condition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it" — fires passively at turn_start_window, no action or resource cost, unlimited uses.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_heroic_inspiration
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect of this feature is granting Heroic Inspiration — a meta-resource that allows rerolling any die. ClassFeatureEffect is currently GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. Neither covers this. The v4 effect atom inventory has no 'grant_heroic_inspiration' or general 'grant_meta_resource' atom.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration" — the payload is the Heroic Inspiration resource, not an extra action or HP heal.

notes: No dhall or JSON authored. The feature is entirely inexpressible in the current surface: (1) ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader requires UseCountResource and RestResetCadence which are both absent — the feature is unlimited and has no rest reset; (2) there is no trigger mechanism for automatic turn-start firing; (3) the effect (Heroic Inspiration) has no atom in v4. Structural widening dominates because even the family shape is wrong — not just a missing variant or atom.
